name: desktop-anime-bot
description: Windows desktop companion prototype with configurable AI providers and independent desktop permissions

scripts.package:win: npm run build:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run build:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --unpacked-only
